Allergen introduction

Fish and shrimp muffins

Halas muffin

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

The fish-only muffins contain egg and fish. Try shrimp only after fish has been tolerated, on a morning when your child is well, chopped fine. Try any first taste in the morning, on a day your child is well, and once an allergen is tolerated keep offering it a few times a week.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 eggs (baked until fully set)
  • 30 g boneless cooked white fish (pollock, cod, or haddock; not shark, swordfish, marlin, or carp)
  • 15 g fully cooked shrimp (later batch only, after fish is tolerated; chopped fine)

Allergens

eggfishcrustacean

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 170 C and beat the eggs.
  2. Stir in flaked boneless white fish that is already fully cooked, with no shrimp yet.
  3. Spoon into small tins and bake until the egg is set in the centre.
  4. Offer these fish-only muffins first.
  5. On a later day, after fish is tolerated, fold finely chopped fully cooked shrimp into the same batter.
  6. Bake until set again, and chop any shrimp piece that is still a chunk.

Adjusted

Shellfish needs its own introduction, separate from the first fish muffins.

Make the fish-only egg muffins first. Add finely chopped fully cooked shrimp only later, after fish has been tolerated, because shrimp is a different allergen.
